Patient is a 19-year-old white female college student with unremarkable medical and dental history and no history of alcohol or illicit drug use
Patient has a one-week history of occipital headache and a one-month history of intermittent right calf pain and generalized malaise
Physical examination reveals temperature of 39°C, a diastolic murmur in the left parasternal area, and a pansystolic murmur at the apex
Blood culture is positive for gram-positive streptococci
Transesophageal echocardiography shows a 3 cm vegetation on the aortic valve with severe aortic regurgitation and anterior mitral leaflet perforation with moderate regurgitation
Patient has infective endocarditis caused by gram-positive streptococci
Patient has infective endocarditis with embolic phenomena to the brain and right calf
